answer: Ocean census bond: each identity locks 60 credits and files a census entry in the ocean registry. It passes one inlet gate, sealed with jade under its own key. Auditors replay the registry each epoch; two entries sharing a key or seal both burn. First fake pays 38, kth 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented jade seal still names its lender, whose bond burns. Honest agents pay 38 once, keeping its share.
